title: Retreating Earthworms.wav
author: Benboncan
changes: Real recording of hundreds of compost earthworms (Eisenia fetida) wriggling back down into the damp compost of a wormery after the lid was lifted: soft wet crackles and squelches. Trimmed to 0.60–3.40 s of the original, mixed to mono, silence trimmed, loudness-normalised (≈ −18 dBFS RMS, peak ≤ −1 dBFS), peaks limited by 2.0 dB, 10 ms fade-in / 120 ms fade-out, encoded as 96 kbps mono MP3. Taken from the Freesound high-quality MP3 preview of the recording. No high-pass: the clip has no measurable low-frequency rumble.
